info.title: After-sales API
info.description: Mode C API of After-sales (SSPS v1). All data lives in the merchant's own database and photos in the merchant's own bucket. Times are ISO-8601 UTC; money is integer minor units with a currency. Errors are RFC 9457 problems (`type` ends with a stable code). POSTs that create or move state require `Idempotency-Key`; replays return the original response. `pk_` keys (browsers, domain-locked) act only for the customer identified by SS-Identity (the website's own login token) or a claim token; `sk_` keys are for the merchant's server.
